products.title: ThinkPad T1g Gen 9
products.description: The Lenovo ThinkPad T1g Gen 9 (16" Intel) is a high-performance AI laptop designed for demanding creative and development workflows. It features Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors with built-in AI acceleration, optional NVIDIA GeForce RTX Blackwell graphics for real-time ray tracing, and Copilot+ integration. The device is built for durability, meeting MIL-STD-810H standards, and offers a wide 16-inch display with options up to a Tandem OLED screen. It includes enterprise-grade security via ThinkShield and a tactile ThinkPad keyboard with TrackPoint.
